orientation_rule: random: undecided pairs oriented with seed crc32(file name)

metric_defs.directed_f1: F1 over directed edges vs G_D (the file's g), undecided pairs at random (seed crc32(file name))
metric_defs.directed_precision: precision over directed edges vs G_D, same rule
metric_defs.directed_recall: recall over directed edges vs G_D, same rule
metric_defs.shd: structural Hamming distance vs G_D: one per unordered pair whose predicted arrows differ from the true arrow(s)
metric_defs.f1_names: directed F1 vs G_N (the file's g_names), same oriented prediction
metric_defs.name_following: among committed arrows on pairs where G_N and G_D differ, the share that are G_N arrows (pooled over files)
metric_defs.data_following: same pairs, the share that are G_D arrows
metric_defs.spearman_f1_data_vs_rho: Spearman correlation of per-file f1_data with rho, per method (P11: <= -0.8 name-reader, |.| <= 0.3 data-only)

controls.knowledge_source: names oracle: returns g_names (G_N) exactly; reads no data

notes: controls.names 'decoupled (rho dial)' is not yet one of score_record.NAMES; add it there before check_scores.py is run on this directory.

files.names_oracle_rows.json: names oracle, 25 dev scenarios x 5 rho x 2 tracks x rep000
files.pc_rows.json: PC (causal-learn 0.1.4.8), 6 dev scenarios (first of each of the first 6 domains) x 5 rho x 2 tracks x rep000
files.pc_dev25_rows.json: PC, all 25 dev scenarios x 5 rho x linear x rep000 (extension check of flatness)
files.b2_sortability.json: generator leakage summary by track x rho over all 2500 files (dev and test; measurement only, no tuning on test)

shd_variant: pair-level SHD (causalarena_io.directed_scores): one per unordered pair whose predicted arrow set differs from the true one, after the random rule
